reference-contract.json inventories WebTransport.getStats(), WebTransportConnectionStats (all 5 Chrome 160 members), and WebTransportDatagramStats (all 4 members) across all 9 dimensions with zero declared-surface gaps.

Clearly separates Chrome 160's shipped field subset from the 9 unshipped W3C spec byte/packet/atSendCapacity fields, documents pooled-connection privacy rules, and explains connecting/closed/failed lifecycle edges.

Embeds live sandboxed Chrome Platform Showcase concept demo (/v160/webtransport-connection-statistics/stats-snapshot/) plus two complete semantic <pre><code> examples covering defensive cross-engine RTT/send-rate polling and post-close datagram counter inspection.

Reconciles BCD api/WebTransport.json (Chrome 'preview', Firefox 114 stub, Safari 26.4, Deno 2.2) with ChromeStatus 160, Firefox 158 release notes, and WebKit-7625.2.8 source (Safari 27.2 default-initialized stats).
